Plot-ready samples of one selected catalog quantity

Source: R/parameter-plot-samples.R
parameter_plot_samples.Rd

Prepare a scalar quantity selected by parameter_catalog_resolve() for plot_posterior(). The list key is the canonical name. The selected posterior carries its prior law, support, structural atoms and defined-draw counts when available. R2 shares are conditional on the term being open.

parameter_plot_samples(
  fit,
  selection,
  conditional = FALSE,
  transform_scaled = TRUE
)

Arguments

fit

Fit produced by JAGS_fit().

selection

A selection of one BayesTools quantity.

conditional

Whether to condition on its declared inclusion event.

transform_scaled

Whether to request the original predictor scale. A pure rescaling of an R2 term transforms the draws, their weights on the fitted coordinates, and their prior together. The coefficient remains in residual-SD units per original predictor unit. When an original-scale R2 coefficient mixes dependent fitted terms with no supported prior law, the method raises BayesTools_R2_density_unavailable. An ordinary scalar fixed coefficient is transformed using the formula posterior interface. An affected fixed factor cell without a scalar display route raises BayesTools_parameter_plot_scale_unavailable. Use FALSE for the fitted scale. Budget shares, totals and rates are unitless.

Value

A named as_mixed_posteriors list with one scalar posterior.

See also

parameter_mixed_posterior(), parameter_relationships()
